data.title: Call for adventure tourism accountability after 2 tourists injured
data.description: PHETCHABUN - Phetchabun authorities face calls to review adventure tourism safety rules and compliance after two foreigners were injured in a fall from a cliff while abseiling over the weekend.

data.title: Korean wanted for child porn distribution arrested in Bangkok
data.description: Police were able to find and detain a 42-year-old South Korean man at a condominium in Bangkok wanted in his home country for allegedly distributing pornographic videos of teenage girls online.

data.title: Koh Samui villa hit by landslide
data.description: SURAT THANI: A villa on Koh Samui was reported hit by landslide on Monday with local administrators warning of more due to rain-soaked soil.

data.title: Jim Thompson goes 'Wild' in Bill Bensley collab
data.description: Jim Thompson has joined creative forces with architect, interior designer, artist and landscape architect Bill Bensley to launch Wild, an exclusive collection inspired by the wildlife and stories of the rainforests in Southeast Asia.

data.title: Dusit Thani Hua Hin Unveils ‘The Art of Celebration’ Festive Season
data.description: Hua Hin, Thailand – October 2026 – Dusit Thani Hua Hin will celebrate Christmas and welcome 2027 with The Art of Celebration, a festive programme running from December 24, 2026, to January 1, 2027. Bringing together the resort’s beachfront setting and distinct dining venues, the programme spans Christmas Eve dinners, Christmas Day brunch and Italian dining, followed by two New Year’s Eve celebrations, fireworks and a relaxed start to the new year.

data.title: Progressive team takes control of Social Security Board
data.description: The Progressive Social Security team has taken control of the Social Security Office Board with a dominating win over their rivals in Sunday's election.

data.title: France's high school students plan fresh protests
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - France's high school students on Monday begin a new stage of their campaign for improved conditions, hoping to maintain the momentum with a fresh wave of demonstrations.

data.title: NZ bank in free speech row over 'explicit' sheep memes
data.description: WELLINGTON - A bank in New Zealand has found itself at the centre of an unlikely free speech row after an attempt to remove "explicit" memes about its sheep mascot from social media.

data.title: Italian rice farmer beats heat with biodiversity haven
data.description: CROVA (ITALY) - Four hundred years after monks transformed a patch of marshlands in northwest Italy into rice fields, farmer Alice Cerutti has restored a third to their natural state, prioritising biodiversity over crop yield.

data.title: Opposition, journalists allege police abuses during India protests
data.description: NEW DELHI - Opposition leaders and journalists accused police of heavy-handed tactics during weekend demonstrations, as authorities locked down New Delhi on Monday ahead of a fresh rally against the election chief.

data.title: The 1’s Gen Z gym membership buyers rise eightfold in 3 years
data.description: The 1’s Gen Z members spend more on sport than travel, with buyer numbers doubling for healthy snacks and alternative drinks over three years.

data.title: Bangkok Bar Show returns
data.description: Bangkok Bar Show returns on Oct 24–25 at Anantara Siam Bangkok, bringing together the bar and beverage community for two days of spirits, cocktails, education and hospitality in the heart of Bangkok.

data.title: Melbourne man linked to suspected flydubai hijacker condemns 'false accusations'
data.description: SYDNEY - A Melbourne man whose Islamic community centre has been linked by prosecutors in the United Arab Emirates to the co-pilot who allegedly attacked the captain of a flydubai jet has hit out at "false accusations".

data.title: Thai economist links Bessent’s IMF–World Bank absence to Trump’s bilateral focus
data.description: Aat Pisanwanich urges Thailand to turn the IMF–World Bank meetings into action on artificial intelligence, growth, digital finance and green investment.

data.title: Delays on Bangkok's Blue Line service
data.description: Trains running on the MRT's Blue Line were experiencing delays of up to 10 minutes on Monday due to a "technical disruption".

data.title: North Korea fires 'several ballistic missiles' into Sea of Japan
data.description: SEOUL - North Korea on Monday fired multiple ballistic missiles off its east coast, Seoul's military said, after weeks of mounting friction over a landmine explosion along their heavily fortified border.

data.title: Flooding continues in Bangkok and 20 provinces
data.description: The Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation reported on Monday that flooding continues to make life wretched for people in parts of Bangkok and 20 provinces, mostly in the Central Plains.

data.title: Nature does not respect borders, UN biodiversity chief warns
data.description: PARIS - War, economic pressure, budget strain -- United Nations biodiversity chief Astrid Schomaker is under no illusions that the coming UN nature summit (COP17) is taking place "in some kind of geopolitical vacuum".

data.title: Man City charges cloud hangs over Premier League season
data.description: LIVERPOOL, England - Manchester City emerged unscathed from a hostile reception at Anfield in their first match since a guilty verdict on widespread financial impropriety, but a 3-0 win over Liverpool highlighted the uncertainty that now surrounds the Premier League season.

data.title: El Nino sets temperature record in key Pacific zone: EU monitor
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - An intensifying El Nino broke a temperature record in a key zone of the Pacific in September, the EU's climate monitor said Monday, in another sign the weather pattern is gaining exceptional strength.

data.title: Riyadh airport hit by fresh Houthi strike day after deadly attack
data.description: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia - A fresh Houthi strike hit Riyadh's international airport on Sunday, killing one person and wounding 11 others, a day after a deadly attack claimed by the Yemeni group forced authorities to suspend operations there.

data.title: Top NATO commander set to issue warning to Russia over any attack
data.description: BRUSSELS (BELGIUM) - NATO's top military commander is expected to deliver a warning to Russia on Monday over the alliance's ability to counter any attack, as worries grow over the threat from Moscow.

data.title: World leaders urged to 'course correct' as UN nature goals fall short
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Nations are steeling for a disappointing report card at this month's UN biodiversity summit, with governments falling short on their commitments to protect the plants, animals and ecosystems that sustain life on Earth.

data.title: Korea Season continues with  'K-Live Festival '
data.description: Top Korean and Thai live bands will be sharing the stage during "K-Live Festival In Bangkok", which will take place at UOB Live, 6th floor of Emsphere, Sukhumvit Road, on Saturday at 5pm.

data.title: 'Emdining J Festival 2026' ends Sunday
data.description: More than 30 leading restaurants within Emporium, EmQuartier and Emsphere present a variety of 100 specially curated vegetarian dishes during "Emdining J Festival 2026" until Sunday.

data.title: Your daily horoscope for Oct 12
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Heavy rain may return to Greater Bangkok on Tuesday
data.description: The Meteorological Department predicts heavy rain will be in the South on Monday and expand to the lower North, the lower Northeast, the Central Plains including Greater Bangkok and the East on Tuesday.

data.title: Stars stacked, Philly now the team to beat
data.description: Now that the Philadelphia 76ers have acquired superstar Jaylen Brown and won the LeBron James free agency lottery, they are just about everyone's pick to notch their first NBA title in 43 years.

data.title: Conservation groups alarmed at marine mammals' deaths in Spain
data.description: NICE (FRANCE) - Conservation groups on Sunday condemned the death of a dolphin transferred from France to a Spanish marine park, saying it added to the deaths of other sea mammals recently moved to Spain from Canada.

data.title: Lula stages mass rally ahead of Brazil's presidential run-off
data.description: SAO PAULO - Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva led a massive rally Sunday to call for more days off for workers ahead of an election runoff against his right-wing opponent Flavio Bolsonaro.

data.title: Policymakers take on energy shock, rising debt at IMF-World Bank meetings
data.description: BANGKOK - Finance ministers and central bankers meet in Bangkok this week for the annual gatherings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank, with the global economy buffeted between the US-Iran war's energy shock, rising debt pressures and the AI boom.

data.title: Raphael Glucksmann elected centre-left French presidential candidate
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Eurodeputy Raphael Glucksmann was on Sunday elected the centre-left candidate for next year's French presidential elections, organisers of the vote said, winning comfortably in the first round.

data.title: That Night I Loved Joshua Wong  staged in honour of HK activist
data.description: To mark one year since the arrest of Hong Kong human rights activist Joshua Wong, Qrious Theatre presents a rehearsed reading of the play That Night I Loved Joshua Wong, at SSS Samyan, Rama IV Road, daily at 7.30pm from Thursday to Sunday.
